en: ...What a restless girl.
Oh, honestly!
I'm in a hurry, so some other time, please!
Truth is, I always oversleep! I'll be late!
What'll they make me do this time? Ugh!
Last time I had to walk around with a bucket on my head!
Oh, we meet again.
Good morning. Looks like I'll just make it
in time today. What a relief.
Putting up with the Baron's whims is hard.
But the pay is good, you know...
Good evening, young lady.
I believe you dropped a handkerchief.
Hm, there are more scattered all about.
Oh! Thank you so much.
Sorry...
I-I have to pick them up, quick...
Hm? There is something written on this.
"To my darling Marvin"
"To the most stylish baron in London"
"To Baron Marvin, with love"
Eeek! D-d-don't read them!
Oh, how embarrassing...
Hmph. What drivel is written here.
What on earth is this?
Do you know Lord Marvin, famous as
the "Eccentric Baron"? This is his new game,
apparently... Sigh...
He eyes the beauties in the street from
upstairs. If one's lovely, he goes down and
has her sign a lace handkerchief. Like so.
...Then we servants sew the handkerchiefs
together to make curtains for the Baron's
room, you see...
Oh, it's just so stupid!
Why do I have to do this stuff?!
Grrr!
...She's gone.
Humans truly seem to be creatures that
squander their time. With lives so short, too.
Oh, I'm so busy!
I'm so swamped I'd take help from the cat!
Good evening. Thanks for the other day...
Working for the Baron is getting
harder and harder for me.
No wonder maids keep quitting in droves.
Oh, good evening. How are you?
Me, I'm worn out...
I mean, I was hired as a cook,
and yet every day I'm ordered to do
nothing but strange jobs... Sigh.
Welcome. Are you a friend of the Baron?
The Baron is in the courtyard.
I merely happened to drop by.
Is the Baron keeping well?
Well, as you'll see for yourself,
he's exasperatingly lively again today.
Right now he's amusing himself with a game.
I see. It is good that he is well.
We servants almost wish he'd fall ill
every once in a while.
Now, now, that won't do. You mustn't say
such reckless things. I'll call again.
Welcome. How may I...
...Oh, you're a friend of the Baron's?
If it's the Baron, he's in the courtyard.
he's in exasperatingly good health.
Oh, I'm so busy my head is spinning.
Today the Baron is out on the terrace.
Seems he's thought up a new game again.
Just wondering if we'll have to join in
makes me dizzy. The dishes aren't done yet!
Hello, and welcome.
Lately you've done nothing but keep us
servants company. I'm terribly sorry.
I can't grumble to my husband at home,
and the Baron will never stop being odd.
We want someone we can talk to, you know.
I'm sure the Baron would like to talk with
you about all sorts of things too.
